name: Rough Wolf Pelts

faq.answer: Helene Peltskinner is a skinner and leatherworker based just outside Goldshire in Elwynn Forest. She prepares hides and fills craft orders for travelers and locals. Her husband is occupied near Northshire Abbey, so she needs help gathering wolf hides for her work.

aliases: what does helene do with pelts
faq.answer: Helene needs wolf pelts to fill her backlog of leather orders near Goldshire. Her husband usually hunts wolves for her work, but his duties elsewhere in Elwynn leave her short on hides. Passing travelers can help by skinning local wolves.
faq.q: Why does Helene need wolf pelts?

faq.answer: Helene's husband is occupied near Northshire Abbey. He usually hunts wolves and gathers skins for her, so his absence leaves Helene needing help to keep up with her orders.

aliases: where to find rough wolf pelts
faq.answer: Timber wolves roam Elwynn Forest's woodlands around Goldshire and Northshire. Skinners harvest their pelts and bring them to Helene's leatherworking post.
faq.q: Where are the wolves found in Elwynn Forest?

aliases: do i need skinning for rough wolf pelts
faq.answer: Yes. Helene offers travelers practice in skinning, and the pelts come from skinning slain wolves. Hunting them alone does not provide the hides she needs.
faq.q: Is skinning required to harvest these pelts?

faq.answer: Helene Peltskinner works near Goldshire, the central settlement of Elwynn Forest. Her work is close to the township, where hunters and travelers on the King's Road can bring her hides from the forest.
faq.q: Where can Helene Peltskinner be found?

sections.body: Just outside Goldshire, Helene Peltskinner supplies travelers and residents with cured leather and furs. Her husband usually hunts Elwynn Forest's timber wolves for her. Now his duties near Northshire Abbey keep him away, while customer orders wait. So Helene asks passing apprentices to skin the local wolves.
sections.title: A Skinner's Need

sections.body: Timber wolves prowl Elwynn Forest's woodlands, farmlands, and roads. Skinning them gives novice skinners practice harvesting hides. Their pelts help Helene continue her leatherwork and keep trade moving through Goldshire. Hunters, too, sharpen their woodcraft.
sections.title: Prowlers of the Forest

summary: Near Goldshire, Rough Wolf Pelts are needed for Helene Peltskinner's leather orders. Her husband is occupied near Northshire Abbey, so she asks for help skinning local wolves.
